traceability.notes:
All acceptance criteria and technical requirements for 002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG are satisfied with concrete implementation and passing tests.
• Core Functionality & Flat Config: src/index.ts defines `configs.recommended` and `configs.strict` as ESLint v9 flat-config arrays of rule severity mappings only, intended to be spread into consumer configs after a `plugins` registration. Tests using FlatESLint confirm these presets correctly enable traceability rules when combined with a base config that registers the plugin.
• ESLint v9 Best Practices & Integration: The presets are pure flat-config objects, compatible with ESLint 9’s flat config model. Integration tests use FlatESLint’s `overrideConfig` arrays to verify behavior, demonstrating seamless composition with other config objects instead of conflicting with them.
• Customizable Paths & Rule Options: valid-story-reference and require-story-annotation rules expose structured schemas with options such as `storyDirectories`, `allowAbsolutePaths`, `requireStoryExtension`, `scope`, and `exportPriority`. Tests assert these schema shapes and enforce `additionalProperties: false`, ensuring documented, validated configurability.
• Config Validation & Error Handling: Configuration validation tests deliberately misconfigure rule options (unknown keys and wrong types) and verify that ESLint throws clear, informative errors that reference the rule name, the offending value, and schema constraints. This matches the requirement for graceful handling of invalid configuration.
• Documentation & UX: The dedicated ESLint 9 Setup Guide plus README references provide comprehensive, concrete examples for JavaScript, TypeScript, mixed projects, monorepos, Node/CommonJS configs, and test files, along with troubleshooting guidance. This fulfills the story’s documentation and user-experience criteria.
Given the presence of targeted tests explicitly tagged to this story, thorough documentation, and the successful full test run, the implementation of this story is complete and currently functioning as specified.
